dedupe_keys.name: multi temporal building footprints kigali rwanda 2006 2022 ground truth for 22 validation areas

description: This dataset provides hand-labelled building footprints over time, from 2006 to 2022, with associated Google Earth imagery (Maxar), for 22 validation areas in Kigali, Rwanda, chosen as a stratified sample of urban Local Climate Zones. It was published on Zenodo on 29 September 2025 by Emily Zuetell as ground truth for a study on hidden Markov methods to build reliable building footprint time series across urban climate risk zones, published in an IOP journal. Shapefiles are named by year, date and area ID, and a separate archive gives each validation area's outline and Local Climate Zone class. Coverage: 22 sample areas in Kigali. Access: a ZIP of about 153 MB and a validation area archive on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free, although the underlying imagery has its own terms. Caveats: sample areas, not the whole city. Simulation uses: validating building change detection and growth of exposure in climate risk zones. Related records: the Kigali building stock typology and GlobalBuildingAtlas.
name: Multi-temporal building footprints, Kigali, Rwanda 2006-2022 (ground truth for 22 validation areas)
